_doc: Shared bot benchmark — ONE set of metrics + targets for all three tracks (A live bot, B FIT, data). Defined by data track from the L10 1v1 re-sim corpus. See BOT_DATA_TIMING_SYNC.md (data -> A, 2026-06-16) for derivation. Two tiers: survivalStress (no opponent, RAW offense + survival) and the contested league (WITH opponent, EFFECTIVE pressure + win%).

offense.definition: sum(width*height) over all garbage sent / game-minutes. Weights chain DEPTH (x8 chain=6x7=42) over combos (~3). Replaces chains/min, which mis-ranks the deep-chain bot.

survival.definition: Survival under standardized incoming garbage matched to human OFFENSE rate. The current '6-wide every 5s' (=72 area/min) is too gentle (~half real pressure).

incoming_spec.hard: scale to 156 area/min (orange) or escalate until topout
incoming_spec.shape_note: bursty chain-blocks are realistic and exercise the break->stop-time loop; uniform rate ok for reproducibility — match the RATE first

survival.clean_board: pass/fail floor only (must NEVER self-topout); not a scored axis

targets.hard_pressure_156_per_min: max survival time = the discriminating score

effective_pressure_note: RAW area/min (survivalStress) overcounts — a real opponent DIGS. EFFECTIVE pressure (un-dug garbage reaching a defending board) + win% require an opponent and live in the contested league (bot/contested_scorecard.py), NOT survivalStress.

timing_controller._doc: Audit-7 stop-time FSM. Adopt the MECHANISM (clock0->RAISE, low->BUILD, high->FIRE+BREAK, proactive lead-time). The per-band human mix below is a REFERENCE/bar-to-exceed, NOT a tune-to-match target — the bot should play these phases OPTIMALLY (superhuman), not reproduce human percentages.

rules.proactive: start fire within leadFrames BEFORE incoming lands (orange 18% preempt, kekeke 83% reactive)

_north_star: CEILING FIRST. Build strictly-better-than-best-human on every axis, THEN tune DOWN for the ladder. NOTHING is tuned toward human level. Every human number here is a FLOOR TO EXCEED, not a match-target. The timing-controller per-band mix is the MECHANISM to adopt (clock0->RAISE, high->FIRE), NOT percentages to reproduce. Down-tuning (cursor speed, fumble, scaled offense) happens ONLY after the bot is superhuman. Style-matched clones are a SEPARATE later layer, not this.

protocol._doc: FROZEN benchmark protocol — run IDENTICALLY every time so numbers are comparable across commits (Brian: track numbers, check the same way as we go). If any param changes, BUMP version and label runs with it, so old/new numbers are never silently compared. Harness-specific values marked PROPOSE pending B's confirmation (B owns survivalStress.lua).
rules: FIXED seeds — same seed set every run, never random (else survival/offense numbers aren't comparable).
FROZEN params — window, seed count, rate range, durations are constants of the protocol version.
APPEND-ONLY log — every run adds a BENCHMARK.md changelog row: date | git SHA | axis | params | number. Never overwrite; the SHA ties the number to exact code.
VERSION on change — alter any param => protocol vN+1; don't compare across versions without a re-run.

survival.cmd: luajit bot/survivalStress.lua <fixed-rate args> (A used `600 5400 3` = 144/min, 90s cap, 3 seeds)
survival.metric: survival TIME (seconds) at FIXED 144 area/min (human rate) — a REAL number, never a '<' bound; once the bot clears the window, RAISE the rate. Adopted per Brian 2026-06-17.
survival.secondary_diagnostic: ceiling = max area/min survived (ramp-to-failure) — keep ONLY when it resolves to a number, not a bound

contested.metric: win% + effective pressure vs a digging opponent (contested_scorecard.py)
